title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Arrives in Turkiye for COP31 Climate Summit

title: Government Announces Relief with Reductions in Petrol and Diesel Prices
summary: Authorities in Pakistan have announced a price cut for petrol and high-speed diesel, marking another consecutive reduction.

The adjustment takes effect on November 11. Media reports noted this marks the sixth straight time that authorities have lowered fuel prices for the public.
